blocks.text: The sweep of control is extended geographically from Panipat to Pathankot, with forts, routes, and offices being watched or held in Banda’s widening sphere.
The text then layers marvel onto governance, suggesting that Banda seems able to appear through barriers, inspect distant posts, and know the state of the land far beyond ordinary means.
Whether read literally or as praise, Panipat to Pathankot marks the scale of his perceived reach and the awe surrounding his authority.
